The '''Third Alabaster''' was the room of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Tomer Darpen/Legends|Tomer Darpen]]. It was on the third floor of the building Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit [[Red Flight]] was billeted to during their diplomatic visit to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
